if a page with that name already exists, you will be editing that page.

{{#forminput:form=Lab Room|size=50|button text=Create or edit lab room}}
</noinclude>
<includeonly>
{{{for template|Lab Room}}}
{{{field|name|mandatory|label=Room Name|input type=text|size=50|hint=e.g., Room 201}}}
{{{field|room_number|mandatory|label=Room Number|input type=text|size=20}}}
{{{field|building|label=Building|input type=text|size=50}}}
{{{field|floor|label=Floor|input type=number|size=10}}}
{{{field|capacity|label=Capacity|input type=number|size=10|hint=Maximum occupancy}}}
{{{field|manager|label=Manager|input type=combobox|values from category=Personnel|autocomplete on property=Personnel Role}}}
{{{field|description|label=Description|input type=textarea|rows=5|hint=Description of the room and its purpose}}}
{{{field|status|mandatory|label=Status|input type=dropdown|values=Active,Inactive,Under Renovation|default=Active}}}
{{{field|created_date|label=Created Date|input type=date}}}
{{{field|last_updated|label=Last Updated|input type=date}}}
{{{standard input|free text|rows=10|label=Additional Notes}}}
{{{standard input|summary}}}
{{{standard input|save}}}
{{{standard input|preview}}}
{{{standard input|changes}}}
{{{standard input|cancel}}}
